more_info.overview: Thaumatin is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, edible ices, cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for permitted food-use exposure in 2021.
Animal studies supported the absence of relevant adverse effects, with moderate confidence in the evidence.
